description: Joins MP3 files end to end, frame by frame with no re-encoding, so nothing is lost. The files must share a sample rate and be all mono or all stereo; mixing formats (WAV, M4A) or adding pauses needs the web page, which decodes in the browser. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

files.description: The MP3 files to join, in the order they should play. At least two. They must share a sample rate and be all mono or all stereo; the result is joined frame by frame, with no re-encoding, so nothing is lost.

items.description: One MP3 to include, in full.

data.description: This MP3's bytes, base64-encoded. A data: URL prefix is stripped.

name.description: Filename, used to name this file in the response and in any error about it.

name: merge_mp3
title: Merge MP3
